transcript: here are things that you don't think matter on your resme but they actually do first is your location I'm going to let you in on a little secret if the position is on site and there are two candidates that are equally as great and one is local and one is not the recruiter is probably going to reach out to the local one first so if you're looking to relocate make sure you put the actual City that you're relocating to on your rese number two is job title if your job title is something that only makes sense internally please change it to whatever recruiters and hiring managers are looking for for whatever field you're in It's usually the first thing that recruiters search for third is your resume format if you have something that is a funky or creative format usually if it gets into the ATS it looks all weird and it's just harder to search so make the job search easier and just use an ATS friendly format you can find a bunch of templates on our website or you can use our free AI Resume Builder
